lines.english: I saw water flowing out of the temple,

lines.latin: et omnes, ad quos pervénit aqua ista,
lines.english: and all to whom that water came
were saved, and they shall say:
Give praise to the Lord, for He is good:
for His mercy endureth for ever.

lines.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
lines.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

lines.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
lines.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

note: the antiphon is repeated after the Gloria Patri in the rite — check the recording and add it if sung
